data.content_ref: inline:The target's central transfer claim — that enforcing strict closure 'will replicate the guaranteed polynomial-time pruning seen in Dung grounded extensions' — is unsubstantiated. Its own disanalogy admits DeepReason operates on 'semantic conditioning of generative models' rather than 'abstract argumentation graphs,' yet provides no formalization, simulation, or evidence to bridge this fundamental gap. The numerically testable claim that 'coverage debt grows monotonically with rivalry size' lacks any sandboxed Python simulation (simulation_refs is empty), the mechanism section cites zero evidence block IDs (violating the problem's requirement to ground claims in attached evidence), and no directed research fetches are proposed despite Dung semantics, Popperian critical rationalism, and peer review all being in-scope on the allowlist.
